title: A moving-average crossover with no lookahead
source:
"""10/40-day SMA crossover backtest with the signal lagged one day.

signal_t   = 1 if SMA10_t > SMA40_t else 0   (0 while SMA40 is undefined)
position_t = signal_{t-1};  position on the first day = 0
ret_t      = close_t / close_{t-1} - 1   (0 on the first day)
strategy_t = position_t * ret_t
total_return = prod(1 + strategy) - 1;  n_trades = days where position changed.
The lag is asserted: no position may equal the SAME day's signal by construction.
"""
import json
import os

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

INPUT = "/input/environment/data/prices.csv"
OUT_DIR = "/app/output"


def main() -> None:
    px = pd.read_csv(INPUT)
    close = px["close"].astype(float)
    fast = close.rolling(10).mean()
    slow = close.rolling(40).mean()
    signal = ((fast > slow) & slow.notna()).astype(int)
    position = signal.shift(1).fillna(0).astype(int)
    asset_ret = close.pct_change().fillna(0.0)
    strat = position * asset_ret

    assert position.iloc[0] == 0
    assert (position.iloc[1:].to_numpy() == signal.iloc[:-1].to_numpy()).all(), "position must lag signal"

    out = pd.DataFrame({"date": px["date"], "fast_ma": fast, "slow_ma": slow,
                        "signal": signal, "position": position, "strategy_return": strat})
    summary = {
        "n_days": int(len(px)),
        "total_return": float(np.prod(1.0 + strat.to_numpy()) - 1.0),
        "n_trades": int((position.diff().fillna(0) != 0).sum()),
    }
    os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    out.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "backtest.csv"), index=False, float_format="%.17g")
    with open(os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "backtest_summary.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        json.dump(summary, fh, indent=2)
    back = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "backtest.csv"))
    assert len(back) == len(px)
    print(summary)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
